note: Infrastructure-only FAILED records archived before relaunch; the 2% stop rule is unchanged.
root_cause: Each PyNEC xq_card on a resident context leaks a result set (~0.116 MB/solve at 1296 segments). Workers grew to the 24 GiB ulimit -v (C++ bad_alloc -> SWIG 'Unknown exception'), then host RAM ran out (numpy 'Unable to allocate'), then w2 was SIGKILLed (exit 137). No physics or data failure is involved.
fix: fork-per-unit isolation, transient classification with retry/backoff, free-RAM admission check
